title: KCP byom_episode_binding_show request (amendment A5 wire name for DESIGN.md §11.6's sage_turn_binding_show; byom §16.6 item 3)
description: Read (no meta at all; §11.2 / R0 KENV-01). The recorded hosted-Episode bindings with their DUAL fence epochs — including fenced rows, which are retained for audit and orphan-result diagnostics. Registry (governed_work_binding_v1): surface operator / human realm-owner principal only — never a service identity, session, assistant, or connector. Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible.

stable_binding_key.description: One binding by its L22 idempotency key.

episode_ref.description: Every binding of one Episode — a successor attempt has its OWN row under a new stable key, so this is how the fenced predecessor stays visible.

args.description: The read target; absent means the realm's whole set.

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
